acceptance: Station value, display, detail, description, and active flag match their input queries; neither absence of problems nor run motion is verified campaign effectiveness.

name: overview-repository-station-presentation-input
subject: Prepare repository coverage for the presentation-ready Overview station.
objective: Format repository reach with its reached and registered counts for the station.
acceptance: The percentage and detail preserve overview-repository-coverage's numerator and denominator; unavailable coverage remains unavailable, not zero or complete reach.

name: overview-repository-station
subject: Provide the presentation-ready repository coverage station for Overview.
objective: Show observed registered-repository worker reach and run motion in one station.
acceptance: Value and formatted evidence match the coverage presentation input, and active matches run motion; neither changes policy or establishes accepted outcomes.

name: overview-disabled-dispatchers
subject: Identify campaigns whose dispatcher is disabled in GitHub Actions.
objective: Surface campaigns with observed inactive orchestrator workflows for operator verification.
acceptance: disabled-dispatchers counts workflow-role orchestrator records with workflow-active false per campaign; verify current GitHub state before acting, and do not infer a policy change.

name: overview-campaign-links
subject: Provide one navigation row per registered campaign that opens its dedicated campaign view.
objective: Let operators navigate to each campaign while showing observed dispatcher and runtime-problem indicators.
acceptance: Each row retains its canonical campaign identity and link, with indicator counts derived only from the named inputs; missing status does not mean enabled or healthy.
description: Registered campaigns with a resolved dashboard link to their dedicated campaign view.

name: campaign-cost-totals
subject: Sum observed AI Credit cost across declared campaign orchestrators and workers.
objective: Attribute retained workflow AIC totals to centrally managed campaigns without computing unrelated inventory metrics.
acceptance: Sum only orchestrator and worker workflow AIC by campaign; missing run observations contribute zero, not proof of zero actual usage.

name: cost-by-campaign
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by centrally managed campaign.
objective: Identify campaigns whose observed AI Credit use needs investigation.
acceptance: Rows preserve native aic values and descending order; investigate fresh campaign runs and snapshot completeness before suggesting a cost intervention, without inferring savings or value.

name: cost-by-repository
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository.
objective: Locate repositories with higher observed AI Credit totals for evidence-led investigation.
acceptance: Each repository coordinate and native aic total agrees with repository-aic-totals; confirm the selected horizon and underlying runs before attributing cost or proposing a change.

name: cost-by-workflow
subject: Present observed AI Credit cost grouped by repository-owned workflow.
objective: Locate repository workflows with higher observed AI Credit totals and open their workflow evidence.
acceptance: Workflow identity, link, and native aic total match workflow-aic-totals in descending order; cost alone does not establish waste, quality, or value.

name: cost-per-workflow-run
subject: Present the average observed AI Credit cost of a single run for each repository-owned workflow.
objective: Compare observed AI Credit per run across repository workflows with each observed-runs denominator.
acceptance: aic-per-run is derived from native aic and observed-runs for matching workflows only; missing or zero denominators remain unavailable, and differences are not claimed as efficiency gains.
description: Observed AI Credit totals divided by observed run attempts for each declared workflow.

name: failure-run-base
subject: Select retained runs with failure, startup-failure, stale, or timed-out conclusions for the failed-run ledger and streak inputs.
objective: Provide one consistent failure-conclusion evidence set to downstream Overview queries.
acceptance: Each selected run has one of the four declared conclusions within the selected horizon; other conclusions remain outside this set, and missing run coverage is not interpreted as no failures.

name: failed-runs
subject: List failed workflow runs that need operator attention.
objective: Give operators the most recent observed failed runs to inspect in GitHub.
acceptance: Unprojected run rows retain available conclusion, started-at, and run evidence fields in descending started-at order; inspect source logs and missing links before attributing a cause or declaring resolution.

name: overview-failing-runs
subject: Identify failed runs in the selected snapshot horizon so subsequent streak logic can use the same declarative failure definition.
objective: Project distinct failure-run counts by organization, repository, workflow, and run for streak joins.
acceptance: Each grouped run identity has a failing-runs count derived from failure-run-base in the selected horizon; this stage does not assert a consecutive streak or require action.

name: overview-failing-workflows
subject: Identify only workflows that have at least one failed run in the selected snapshot horizon before computing streaks.
objective: Provide workflow identities with observed failed runs for the streak computation.
acceptance: Each organization/repository/workflow group has a distinct failing-runs count from overview-failing-runs; the count covers observed failures, not the latest consecutive streak.

name: overview-repeated-failure-groups
subject: Group each workflow's latest consecutive failing run sequence in the selected snapshot horizon, resetting the group after any successful run.
objective: Project the latest observed consecutive failure-count per workflow for downstream blocked-work matching.
acceptance: failure-count follows run ordering and the declared latest-failure-streak reducer, with non-failing runs breaking the streak; missing earlier runs or incomplete snapshots limit the observed sequence.

name: overview-repeated-failure-candidates
subject: Attach selected-horizon failure counts to each workflow's latest canonical work item.
objective: Pair blocked work items with observed workflow failure streaks and retained run evidence before attention filtering.
acceptance: Candidates are filtered to blocked items with a matching organization/repository/workflow streak; is-repeated reflects failure-count greater than one, while selected evidence-link and run-link can be absent or refer to the work item rather than the latest failed run.

name: overview-repeated-failure-attention
subject: Keep only unresolved workflows with two or more failures in the selected horizon.
objective: Surface blocked workflow items with observed repeated failures for bounded run investigation.
acceptance: Every row inherits a blocked item with is-repeated true and projects evidence-link and run-link when available; verify run order, links, and current state before treating the failure as still unresolved.

name: overview-review-attention
subject: Select only unresolved outputs explicitly awaiting human review with their retained GitHub evidence destination.
objective: Present review-state work items and their retained GitHub destination to a human reviewer.
acceptance: Rows are filtered to lifecycle-state review and project the work-item ID as attention-signal-id, plus reason, evidence-link, and run-link where present; reviewer disposition must be checked at source.

name: overview-needs-attention
subject: Combine grouped repeated failures and unresolved review outputs without introducing ordinary activity or duplicate work items.
objective: Prioritize observed blocked repeated-failure work and review-state outputs for investigation.
acceptance: Rows come only from the repeated-failure or review inputs and retain their source reasons, links, and ordering; confirm fresh source status before acting, and do not equate a missing row with resolved work.

name: domain-route-record
subject: Project the selected domain header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected domain and open a retained run before investigating its traffic evidence.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected domain and a run link from its retained observations; missing observations or links remain unavailable, and a header does not establish access policy or traffic completeness.

name: tool-route-record
subject: Project the selected MCP tool header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected MCP tool and open a retained run before investigating its call evidence.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected MCP tool label and a run link from its retained calls; absent calls or links remain unavailable and do not imply zero usage or tool effectiveness.

name: audit-route-record
subject: Project the selected audit summary header and one retained run link.
objective: Identify the selected audit summary and open a retained run before investigating its observations.
acceptance: The route header preserves the selected event summary and a run link from its retained audit observations; absent evidence remains unavailable and neither the header nor its absence establishes incident severity or a clean audit.

name: domain-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one domain entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Identify domain decisions with request volume worth investigating before considering any egress change.
acceptance: For the selected domain, request totals match the retained domain observations grouped by decision; missing data or blocked traffic does not establish a need for access, which requires underlying request and policy review.

name: tool-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one tool entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Select a tool and status combination whose recorded call volume merits investigation.
acceptance: For the selected tool, observation counts match retained MCP call observations grouped by server, tool, and status; missing calls are not zero usage and status counts do not establish effectiveness or cause.

name: audit-entity-insights
subject: Summarize one audit event entity for its dedicated Insights view.
objective: Select an audit summary and status requiring closer review of underlying observations.
acceptance: For the selected summary, counts agree with retained audit observation IDs grouped by event status; repeated observations are not silently treated as distinct incidents, and absence does not prove no findings.
